accepted_previous_inputs_and_deductions: P=(0,0), Q=(1,0) form a Z_11-basis of E(Q) tensor Z_11.
a_11=-4; good ordinary and non-anomalous at 11.
Split multiplicative at 389, with local 11-adic correction a unit.
The ordinary cyclotomic height matrix in the stated normalization has unit determinant.
The primitive ordinary p-adic L-function is t^2 times a Z_11[[t]] unit.
The primitive derived Kato class exists integrally and is primitive.
Prior modular-symbol period lattice and smoothing comparisons are units, with absolute canonical scale not numerically computed.

normalization.height: BKS negative Bockstein convention; negative of the positive-Bockstein matrix in Attack 05, with the same rank-two determinant
normalization.period: Integral of the fixed positive rational Betti cycle; a period change must simultaneously rescale the p-adic L-function and Kato class
normalization.Kato: Standard dagger class, with Coleman(z_dagger)=L_11 exactly in consistent involution convention
normalization.scalar: s_11=a_2 / ((1-alpha^-1)^2 det H); unknown, not set to 1
